challenge.title: Talk About Your Work or Studies
challenge.instructions: Write and say a short Moroccan conversation of at least 10 lines about your work or studies and your plans for the future. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 8 and include both a masculine-address form and a feminine-address form.
required_elements: A question about profession using شنو كتخدم or شنو كتخدمي.
An answer naming a job or field of study.
A question about where someone works or studies using فين.
A mention of years of experience or year of study using سنة or سنين.
A future plan using غادي or بغيت or ناوي.
A mention of an ambition or dream using الطموح or الحلم.
The phrase إن شاء الله after a future plan.
A closing exchange such as الله يوفقك or بسلامة.

dialogue.english: I work as a lawyer in a small office. And you?

dialogue.speaker: خالد
dialogue.arabic: أنا باقي كنقرا الاقتصاد فالجامعة، فالسنة الرابعة.
dialogue.transliteration: ana baqi kanqra liqtisad f ljam3a, f ssna rrabi3a.
dialogue.english: I'm still studying economics at university, in the fourth year.

dialogue.speaker: مايا
dialogue.arabic: ما شاء الله. ومن بعد التخرج، شنو ناوي تدير؟
dialogue.transliteration: ma sha2 llah. w mn b3d ttakharruj, shnu nawi tdir?
dialogue.english: God bless. And after graduating, what do you plan to do?

dialogue.speaker: خالد
dialogue.arabic: غادي نقدم على خدمة فشي بنك، إن شاء الله نلقى حاجة مزيانة.
dialogue.transliteration: ghadi nqeddem 3la khedma f shi bank, in sha2 llah nlqa 7aja mzyana.
dialogue.english: I'll apply for a job at a bank, God willing I'll find something good.

dialogue.speaker: مايا
dialogue.arabic: وفين غادي تكون من هنا لخمس سنين؟
dialogue.transliteration: w feen ghadi tkun mn hna l-khmes snin?
dialogue.english: And where will you be in five years?

dialogue.speaker: خالد
dialogue.arabic: الطموح ديالي هو نولي مدير فبنك كبير.
dialogue.transliteration: ttumu7 dyali huwa nwelli mudir f bank kbir.
dialogue.english: My ambition is to become a manager in a big bank.

dialogue.speaker: مايا
dialogue.arabic: وأنا الحلم ديالي هو نحل مكتب ديالي.
dialogue.transliteration: w ana l7olm dyali huwa n7ell maktab dyali.
dialogue.english: And my dream is to open my own office.

dialogue.speaker: خالد
dialogue.arabic: شحال هادي وانتي كتخدمي فهاد المكتب؟
dialogue.transliteration: shhal hadi w nti katkhdemi f had lmaktab?
dialogue.english: How long have you been working in this office?

dialogue.speaker: مايا
dialogue.arabic: هادي جوج سنين. الحمد لله، الخدمة ديالي مزيانة.
dialogue.transliteration: hadi juj snin. l7amdulillah, lkhedma dyali mzyana.
dialogue.english: Two years. Thank God, my job is good.

dialogue.speaker: خالد
dialogue.arabic: الله يوفقك، آ مايا.
dialogue.transliteration: llah iwaffeqek, a Maya.
dialogue.english: May God grant you success, Maya.

dialogue.speaker: مايا
dialogue.arabic: ويوفقك. بسلامة!
dialogue.transliteration: w iwaffeqek. bslama!
dialogue.english: And you. Goodbye!
